description: A line of four walks back up the hall the way it came.

walkthrough.line: In the same line of four, walk back up the hall the way you came.
walkthrough.teach: Still holding the hands beside you, walk back up the hall to where the line started. The caller reads the order out again because turning as couples changed it: whoever was on the end of the line is beside you now. You end facing up the hall.

call.4: UP THE HALL FOUR IN LINE
